headline: Settings import and export now reads pasted strings strictly as data and uses a new compressed format.

entries.title: Compressed "!BB2!" export format
entries.details: Exports from Settings -> Profiles -> Import / Export now use a new compressed "!BB2!" format. Older "!BB" export strings still import.

entries.title: Read imported strings strictly as data
entries.details: Settings -> Profiles -> Import / Export now reads pasted strings as data instead of running them as code. Unsafe or invalid strings are rejected without changing your saved categories.
